title: Trying to remember the bass player
summary: Holmes cannot recall the bassist's name, ruling out Al Hall and others.

blocks.x: Do you remember the name of the bass player?

No. I couldn't think of it the last time I was talking to you about it. And I know him so well! He's one of the big ones. I mean, he's always working downtown, I mean all the time. Him and Hinton and this tall fellow plays...
No. He used to have nice, pretty long hair. Now he's all bald-headed. I don't know why... Some people you just... It just don't come to me.
